## addSarifComment() function

Adds one finding on a line or line range to a copy of a SARIF document.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function addSarifComment(sarif: object, comment: ISarifComment): AddSarifCommentOutcome;
```

**Returns:**

[AddSarifCommentOutcome](./sarif-to-comment.addsarifcommentoutcome.md)

`added` with the new document, or `invalid` if the input is not schema-valid SARIF or has no run.

## Exceptions

`TypeError` for a malformed comment, a run index out of range, or a document with several runs and no `run` choice.

## Remarks

Works on any schema-valid SARIF, whether it came from[createSarifDocument()](./sarif-to-comment.createsarifdocument.md) or from another producer. The input is copied and never changed; every existing run, finding and property is kept. Only what you supply is written: no source is read, so lines are checked later, by [addStagedChangesToSarif()](./sarif-to-comment.addstagedchangestosarif.md) and by publication.

## Example


```ts
import { createSarifDocument, addSarifComment } from 'sarif-to-comment';

let sarif = createSarifDocument({ tool: { name: 'Review agent' } });
const added = addSarifComment(sarif, { file: 'src/parse.js', line: 2, message: 'Handle empty input.' });
if (added.status === 'added') sarif = added.sarif;
```
